doc: Screen part of s-reading: the interlude `boal_frame` over the whole screen. The game's frame box (SCROLLPICT 25,20–775,580 of boal_frame.ini, 750:560) as tall as the screen holds the `picture` (a game texture, or null), stretched to the box as the game draws it, and the `text` inside the game's INFO_TEXT margins (60,50–740,550), wrapped and centred; a picture without a line is shown unshaded. A tap anywhere reports `click` (the game's own way out), silently as the game's Esc (no interface click: a frame whose Esc the quest locks would click for nothing).
